description.value: Oyama Sausage is a celebrated artisan charcuterie shop founded over 30 years ago and now located inside the historic Granville Island Public Market. Founded by fifth-generation charcutier John van der Lieck, the shop produces over 400 products annually including fresh sausages, cured salamis, hams, pâtés, terrines, and a curated selection of cheeses. Its multicultural Vancouver flavour profile — think Butter Chicken Sausage alongside classic saucisson sec — makes it a distinctive provisioning stop for touring cyclists exploring the city.
